headword: {遺伝情報|いでんじょうほう}

definitions.explanation: The biological instructions encoded in DNA that determine the characteristics of a living organism. Used in biology, medicine, and discussions about heredity and genetics.

examples.japanese: DNAには{遺伝情報|いでんじょうほう}が{含|ふく}まれている。
{遺伝情報|いでんじょうほう}は{親|おや}から{子|こ}に{受|う}け{継|つ}がれる。
examples.english: Genetic information is passed from parent to child.

examples.japanese: {近年|きんねん}、{個人|こじん}の{遺伝情報|いでんじょうほう}を{解析|かいせき}して{病気|びょうき}のリスクを{予測|よそく}する{技術|ぎじゅつ}が{進|すす}んでいる。
examples.english: In recent years, technology for analyzing individual genetic information to predict disease risk has advanced.

notes:
Composed of {遺伝|いでん} (heredity, genetics) and {情報|じょうほう} (information). A fundamental term in biology and medicine. With advances in genetic testing and personalized medicine, this term appears frequently in news and health discussions. Japan enacted the {個人|こじん}{遺伝情報|いでんじょうほう}{保護|ほご}ガイドライン to regulate the handling of personal genetic data.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {遺伝情報|いでんじょうほう}の{解析|かいせき}: analysis of genetic information
- {遺伝情報|いでんじょうほう}を{読|よ}み{取|と}る: to read genetic information
- {遺伝情報|いでんじょうほう}の{保護|ほご}: protection of genetic information

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ゲノム: genome — the complete set of genetic information in an organism
- {遺伝子|いでんし}: gene — a specific unit of hereditary information within DNA
- DNA: でぃーえぬえー — the molecule that carries genetic information
